data.name: PAROLE Eligibility — Who may obtain parole?
data.notes: Official current guidance. It describes the calculating authority and general eligibility mechanics; it does not state Eugenio Les Zavala's personal eligibility date.
data.publisher: Texas Department of Criminal Justice / Texas Board of Pardons and Paroles

sources.title: PAROLE Eligibility — Who may obtain parole?

summary: Current Texas Board of Pardons and Paroles guidance states that TDCJ Correctional Institutions Division Records calculates parole-eligibility dates, that the portion of a sentence required before eligibility varies by offense and statute, and that good-conduct time can affect the eligibility date.
title: Texas BPP parole eligibility guidance
